senses.gloss: ch. same, to force, overwhelm; to rob.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Hosea 7:1">Targ. Hos. VII, 1</cite> <he>קָפְחִין</he> (not <he>קַפָּחִין</he>).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 20:5:2">Y. Sabb. XX, end, 17ᵈ</cite> <he>קְפוֹחַ קְפִיחָה</he> rob him that has been robbed (v. <cite ref="R00623"><he>צְנִינִים</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Yoma 83b:11">Yoma 83ᵇ</cite> <he>קַפְּחֵיה לרועה וכ׳</he> he overpowered the shepherd and ate his bread.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 75">Gen. R. s. 75</cite>, beg. <he>שרי מְקַפֵּחַ ביה</he> began to rob him.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 87">Gen. R. s. 87</cite> <he>הא … קום קַפְּחִינָהּ</he> the she-bear is before thee, rise and overpower her, i.e. here is a temptation, conquer it.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <he>לסטין אתאן למְקַפְּחָא יתי</he> robbers are coming to rob me.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>קַפְּחֵיה ונסב וכ׳</he> he overpowered him and took all he had.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:6">Ib.</cite> <he>הב … דקַפַּחְתַּנִי</he> give me back what thou hast robbed me of.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:6">Ib.</cite> <he>מן כל מה דקַפְּחִית וכ׳</he> of all I forced (out of thee) and of all I took, this man has (I have) nothing left except this rug.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:26">Koh. R. to VII, 26</cite> <he>והוא נפיק ומקפח בליליא</he> and he used to go out by night for robbery; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Gittin 29b:12">Gitt. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>קַפְּחִינְהוּ רב ספרא וכ׳</he> R. Safra got the better of three ordained rabbis; <he>קפחינהו … בטעותא</he> R. S. got the better of …, by showing them their mistake.

senses.gloss: to be overpowered, robbed. Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵇ bot. [read:] ר׳ יוחנן א׳ בעלי וכ׳, v. קַנְיָיה.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>אִיקַּפְחִית וכ׳</he> (not <he>איקפחת</he>) I have been robbed &c.
